Corsets, costumes, chaos — come exactly as you are. 💄🖤

Rocky Horror night means everybody gets to be a little extra. Fishnets, time-warp fits, Frank-N-Furter glam — Azúcar's dance floor is the one place in Pasco where all of it belongs. Cherry Pop's shadow cast leads the charge with the movie, props flying, callbacks loud, solo performances opening the show before the main event even starts. 🎭

This crowd doesn't just watch the show — it IS the show.

🗓️ Thursday, October 29 • Doors 7pm, Show 8pm
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🎟️ $15 Entry
🔞 18+
